algebraic.description: real algebraic number package. Non-default parameter settings are not supported

factor.description: use polynomial factorization to simplify polynomials representing algebraic numbers

factor_max_prime.description: parameter for the polynomial factorization procedure in the algebraic number module. Z3 polynomial factorization is composed of three steps: factorization in GF(p), lifting and search. This parameter limits the maximum prime number p to be used in the first step

factor_num_primes.description: parameter for the polynomial factorization procedure in the algebraic number module. Z3 polynomial factorization is composed of three steps: factorization in GF(p), lifting and search. The search space may be reduced by factoring the polynomial in different GF(p)'s. This parameter specify the maximum number of finite factorizations to be considered, before lifting and searching

factor_search_size.description: parameter for the polynomial factorization procedure in the algebraic number module. Z3 polynomial factorization is composed of three steps: factorization in GF(p), lifting and search. This parameter can be used to limit the search space

min_mag.description: Z3 represents algebraic numbers using a (square-free) polynomial p and an isolating interval (which contains one and only one root of p). This interval may be refined during the computations. This parameter specifies whether to cache the value of a refined interval or not. It says the minimal size of an interval for caching purposes is 1/2^16

zero_accuracy.description: one of the most time-consuming operations in the real algebraic number module is determining the sign of a polynomial evaluated at a sample point with non-rational algebraic number values. Let k be the value of this option. If k is 0, Z3 uses precise computation. Otherwise, the result of a polynomial evaluation is considered to be 0 if Z3 can show it is inside the interval (-1/2^k, 1/2^k)

combined_solver.description: combines two solvers: non-incremental (solver1) and incremental (solver2)

ignore_solver1.description: if true, solver 2 is always used

solver2_timeout.description: fallback to solver 1 after timeout even when in incremental model

solver2_unknown.description: what should be done when solver 2 returns unknown: 0 - just return unknown, 1 - execute solver 1 if quantifier free problem, 2 - execute solver 1

inf_precision.description: a value k that is the initial interval size (i.e., (0, 1/2^l)) used as an approximation for infinitesimal values

initial_precision.description: a value k that is the initial interval size (as 1/2^k) when creating transcendentals and approximated division

lazy_algebraic_normalization.description: during sturm-seq and square-free polynomial computations, only normalize algebraic polynomial expressions when the defining polynomial is monic

max_precision.description: during sign determination we switch from interval arithmetic to complete methods when the interval size is less than 1/2^k, where k is the max_precision

spacer.iuc.debug_proof.description: prints proof used by unsat-core-learner for debugging purposes (debugging)

spacer.iuc.old_hyp_reducer.description: use old hyp reducer instead of new implementation, for debugging only

spacer.iuc.print_farkas_stats.description: prints for each proof how many Farkas lemmas it contains and how many of these participate in the cut (for debugging)

spacer.logic.description: SMT-LIB logic to configure internal SMT solvers

spacer.max_num_contexts.description: maximal number of contexts to create

spacer.order_children.description: SPACER: order of enqueuing children in non-linear rules : 0 (original), 1 (reverse), 2 (random)

spacer.push_pob.description: push blocked pobs to higher level

spacer.push_pob_max_depth.description: Maximum depth at which push_pob is enabled

spacer.random_seed.description: Random seed to be used by SMT solver

spacer.reset_pob_queue.description: SPACER: reset pob obligation queue when entering a new level

spacer.simplify_lemmas_post.description: simplify derived lemmas after inductive propagation

spacer.simplify_lemmas_pre.description: simplify derived lemmas before inductive propagation

spacer.simplify_pob.description: simplify pobs by removing redundant constraints

spacer.use_array_eq_generalizer.description: SPACER: attempt to generalize lemmas with array equalities

spacer.use_derivations.description: SPACER: using derivation mechanism to cache intermediate results for non-linear rules

spacer.use_euf_gen.description: Generalize lemmas and pobs using implied equalities

spacer.use_inc_clause.description: Use incremental clause to represent trans

spacer.use_iuc.description: Enable Interpolating Unsat Core(IUC) for lemma generalization

spacer.use_lemma_as_cti.description: SPACER: use a lemma instead of a CTI in flexible_trace

spacer.use_lim_num_gen.description: Enable limit numbers generalizer to get smaller numbers

tab.selection.description: selection method for tabular strategy: weight (default), first, var-use

validate.description: validate result (by proof checking or model checking)

xform.array_blast.description: try to eliminate local array terms using Ackermannization -- some array terms may remain

xform.array_blast_full.description: eliminate all local array variables by QE

xform.elim_term_ite.inflation.description: Maximum inflation for non-Boolean ite-terms blasting: 0 (none), k (multiplicative)

xform.inline_linear_branch.description: try linear inlining method with potential expansion

xform.instantiate_arrays.description: Transforms P(a) into P(i, a[i] a)

xform.instantiate_arrays.enforce.description: Transforms P(a) into P(i, a[i]), discards a from predicate

xform.instantiate_arrays.nb_quantifier.description: Gives the number of quantifiers per array

xform.instantiate_quantifiers.description: instantiate quantified Horn clauses using E-matching heuristic

xform.quantify_arrays.description: create quantified Horn clauses from clauses with arrays

xform.scale.description: add scaling variable to linear real arithmetic clauses

xform.subsumption_checker.description: Enable subsumption checker (no support for model conversion)

xform.transform_arrays.description: Rewrites arrays equalities and applies select over store

xform.unfold_rules.description: unfold rules statically using iterative squaring

smt.description: smt solver based on lazy smt

arith.bprop_on_pivoted_rows.description: propagate bounds on rows changed by the pivot operation

arith.branch_cut_ratio.description: branch/cut ratio for linear integer arithmetic

arith.dump_bound_lemmas.description: dump linear solver bounds to files in smt2 format

arith.dump_lemmas.description: dump arithmetic theory lemmas to files

arith.epsilon.description: initial value of epsilon used for model generation of infinitesimals

arith.nl.description: (incomplete) nonlinear arithmetic support based on Groebner basis and interval propagation, relevant only if smt.arith.solver=2

arith.nl.branching.description: branching on integer variables in non linear clusters

arith.nl.delay.description: number of calls to final check before invoking bounded nlsat check

arith.nl.grobner_cnfl_to_report.description: grobner's maximum number of conflicts to report

arith.nl.grobner_exp_delay.description: use exponential delay between grobner basis attempts

arith.nl.grobner_expand_terms.description: expand terms before computing grobner basis

arith.nl.grobner_gcd_test.description: detect gcd conflicts for polynomial powers x^k - y = 0

arith.nl.grobner_propagate_quotients.description: detect conflicts x*y + z = 0 where x doesn't divide z

arith.nl.grobner_row_length_limit.description: row is disregarded by the heuristic if its length is longer than the value

arith.nl.grobner_subs_fixed.description: 0 - no subs, 1 - substitute, 2 - substitute fixed zeros only

arith.nl.horner_row_length_limit.description: row is disregarded by the heuristic if its length is longer than the value

arith.nl.horner_subs_fixed.description: 0 - no subs, 1 - substitute, 2 - substitute fixed zeros only

arith.nl.log.description: Log lemmas sent to nra solver

arith.nl.nra.description: call nra_solver when incremental linearization does not produce a lemma, this option is ignored when arith.nl=false, relevant only if smt.arith.solver=6

arith.nl.reduce_pseudo_linear.description: create incremental linearization axioms for pseudo-linear monomials

arith.nl.rounds.description: threshold for number of (nested) final checks for non linear arithmetic, relevant only if smt.arith.solver=2

arith.propagation_mode.description: 0 - no propagation, 1 - propagate existing literals, 2 - refine finite bounds

arith.random_initial_value.description: use random initial values in the simplex-based procedure for linear arithmetic

arith.rep_freq.description: the report frequency, in how many iterations print the cost and other info

arith.solver.description: arithmetic solver: 0 - no solver, 1 - bellman-ford based solver (diff. logic only), 2 - simplex based solver, 3 - floyd-warshall based solver (diff. logic only) and no theory combination 4 - utvpi, 5 - infinitary lra, 6 - lra solver

arith.validate.description: validate lemmas generated by arithmetic solver

bv.enable_int2bv.description: enable support for int2bv and bv2int operators

bv.reflect.description: create enode for every bit-vector term

bv.size_reduce.description: pre-processing; turn assertions that set the upper bits of a bit-vector to constants into a substitution that replaces the bit-vector with constant bits. Useful for minimizing circuits as many input bits to circuits are constant

bv.solver.description: bit-vector solver engine: 0 - bit-blasting, 1 - polysat, 2 - intblast, requires sat.smt=true

bv.watch_diseq.description: use watch lists instead of eager axioms for bit-vectors

candidate_models.description: create candidate models even when quantifier or theory reasoning is incomplete

case_split.description: 0 - case split based on variable activity, 1 - similar to 0, but delay case splits created during the search, 2 - similar to 0, but cache the relevancy, 3 - case split based on relevancy (structural splitting), 4 - case split on relevancy and activity, 5 - case split on relevancy and current goal, 6 - activity-based case split with theory-aware branching activity

core.extend_nonlocal_patterns.description: extend unsat cores with literals that have quantifiers with patterns that contain symbols which are not in the quantifier's body

core.extend_patterns.description: extend unsat core with literals that trigger (potential) quantifier instances

core.extend_patterns.max_distance.description: limits the distance of a pattern-extended unsat core

core.minimize.description: minimize unsat core produced by SMT context

core.validate.description: [internal] validate unsat core produced by SMT context. This option is intended for debugging

dack.description: 0 - disable dynamic ackermannization, 1 - expand Leibniz's axiom if a congruence is the root of a conflict, 2 - expand Leibniz's axiom if a congruence is used during conflict resolution

dack.eq.description: enable dynamic ackermannization for transitivity of equalities

dack.gc.description: Dynamic ackermannization garbage collection frequency (per conflict)

dack.threshold.description: number of times the congruence rule must be used before Leibniz's axiom is expanded

delay_units.description: if true then z3 will not restart when a unit clause is learned

delay_units_threshold.description: maximum number of learned unit clauses before restarting, ignored if delay_units is false

dt_lazy_splits.description: How lazy datatype splits are performed: 0- eager, 1- lazy for infinite types, 2- lazy

lemma_gc_strategy.description: lemma garbage collection strategy: 0 - fixed, 1 - geometric, 2 - at restart, 3 - none

logic.description: logic used to setup the SMT solver

macro_finder.description: try to find universally quantified formulas that can be viewed as macros

max_conflicts.description: maximum number of conflicts before giving up.

mbqi.force_template.description: some quantifiers can be used as templates for building interpretations for functions. Z3 uses heuristics to decide whether a quantifier will be used as a template or not. Quantifiers with weight >= mbqi.force_template are forced to be used as a template

mbqi.id.description: Only use model-based instantiation for quantifiers with id's beginning with string

mbqi.max_cexs.description: initial maximal number of counterexamples used in MBQI, each counterexample generates a quantifier instantiation

mbqi.max_cexs_incr.description: increment for MBQI_MAX_CEXS, the increment is performed after each round of MBQI

mbqi.max_iterations.description: maximum number of rounds of MBQI

mbqi.trace.description: generate tracing messages for Model Based Quantifier Instantiation (MBQI). It will display a message before every round of MBQI, and the quantifiers that were not satisfied

pb.learn_complements.description: learn complement literals for Pseudo-Boolean theory

phase_caching_off.description: number of conflicts while phase caching is off

phase_caching_on.description: number of conflicts while phase caching is on

phase_selection.description: phase selection heuristic: 0 - always false, 1 - always true, 2 - phase caching, 3 - phase caching conservative, 4 - phase caching conservative 2, 5 - random, 6 - number of occurrences, 7 - theory

q.lift_ite.description: 0 - don not lift non-ground if-then-else, 1 - use conservative ite lifting, 2 - use full lifting of if-then-else under quantifiers

q.lite.description: Use cheap quantifier elimination during pre-processing

qi.cost.description: expression specifying what is the cost of a given quantifier instantiation

qi.max_multi_patterns.description: specify the number of extra multi patterns

qi.profile_freq.description: how frequent results are reported by qi.profile

qi.quick_checker.description: specify quick checker mode, 0 - no quick checker, 1 - using unsat instances, 2 - using both unsat and no-sat instances

qsat_use_qel.description: Use QEL for lite quantifier elimination and model-based projection in QSAT

quasi_macros.description: try to find universally quantified formulas that are quasi-macros

random_seed.description: random seed for the smt solver

relevancy.description: relevancy propagation heuristic: 0 - disabled, 1 - relevancy is tracked by only affects quantifier instantiation, 2 - relevancy is tracked, and an atom is only asserted if it is relevant

restart_factor.description: when using geometric (or inner-outer-geometric) progression of restarts, it specifies the constant used to multiply the current restart threshold

restricted_quasi_macros.description: try to find universally quantified formulas that are restricted quasi-macros

seq.max_unfolding.description: maximal unfolding depth for checking string equations and regular expressions

seq.min_unfolding.description: initial bound for strings whose lengths are bounded by iterative deepening. Set this to a higher value if there are only models with larger string lengths

seq.split_w_len.description: enable splitting guided by length constraints

seq.validate.description: enable self-validation of theory axioms created by seq theory

sls.enable.description: enable sls co-processor with SMT engine

sls.parallel.description: use sls co-processor in parallel or sequential with SMT engine

solve_eqs.non_ground.description: pre-processing: solve equalities. Allow eliminating variables by non-ground solutions which can break behavior for model evaluation.

string_solver.description: solver for string/sequence theories. options are: 'z3str3' (specialized string solver), 'seq' (sequence solver), 'auto' (use static features to choose best solver), 'empty' (a no-op solver that forces an answer unknown if strings were used), 'none' (no solver)

theory_aware_branching.description: Allow the context to use extra information from theory solvers regarding literal branching prioritization.

theory_case_split.description: Allow the context to use heuristics involving theory case splits, which are a set of literals of which exactly one can be assigned True. If this option is false, the context will generate extra axioms to enforce this instead.

threads.max_conflicts.description: maximal number of conflicts between rounds of cubing for parallel SMT

up.persist_clauses.description: replay propagated clauses below the levels they are asserted

error_for_visual_studio.description: display error messages in Visual Studio format

ignore_user_patterns.description: ignore patterns provided by the user
